items.title: Mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy murder case
items.summary: A judge declared a mistrial in Lindsay Clancy's trial for murdering her three children after the jury deadlocked, 11-1 for acquittal according to her lawyer. #IAmTheHoldout trended as the lone holdout became the story.
items.author: @nicksortor
